title: Stock Option Grant Notice and Agreement

issues.anchor: and Company shall make each determination
issues.quote: "Cause" means (a) Optionee's conviction of a felony, (b) Optionee's fraud against Company, or (c) Optionee's breach of Optionee's confidentiality obligations to Company, and Company shall make each determination of Cause in good faith.
issues.why: The definition of "Cause" contains an obligation.
issues.fix: End the definition after clause (c); put the good-faith duty in its own sentence (for example, in the section titled "Expiration").

issues.quote: The Option expires on the earlier of the 10th anniversary of the Grant Date or the date that is 3 months after Optionee's Service terminates.
issues.fix: The Option expires on the earlier of (a) the 10th anniversary of the Grant Date and (b) the date that is 3 months after Optionee's Service terminates.

issues.quote: After Optionee's Service terminates for any reason other than Cause, Optionee may exercise the vested portion of the Option for 90 days.
issues.why: E.2's 90-day post-termination exercise period conflicts with E.1's 3 months (3 calendar months can be 89 to 92 days).
issues.fix: Use 1 measure in both places, for example 3 months, and have E.2 refer to the expiration rule.

issues.quote: If Company shall effect a stock split, reverse stock split, or stock dividend, Company shall adjust the number of Shares and the exercise price proportionately.
issues.fix: If Company effects a stock split, reverse stock split, or stock dividend, ...

issues.quote: Optionee may transfer the Option only by will or by the laws of descent and distribution, and no transferee shall exercise the Option until the transferee gives Company a copy of the will or court order under which the transferee received the Option.
issues.why: "shall" with a negative subject, hidden mid-sentence.
issues.fix: and no transferee may exercise the Option until ...

traps.anchor: To exercise the Option, Optionee must
traps.quote: To exercise the Option, Optionee must give Company notice stating the number of Shares that Optionee elects to buy and must pay the exercise price for those Shares in full.
traps.why_correct: "must" in a condition is correct; it states what Optionee needs to do to exercise, not a duty.

traps.anchor: Section 422 of the Internal Revenue Code
traps.quote: The Option is a nonqualified stock option and is not an incentive stock option under Section 422 of the Internal Revenue Code.

traps.anchor: the day on which Company receives
traps.quote: An exercise is effective on the day on which Company receives both the notice and the payment.
Company is not required to issue any fractional Share.

traps.anchor: the terms of the Company Plan
traps.quote: If this agreement conflicts with the terms of the Company Plan, the Company Plan controls.
traps.why_correct: "the" goes with "Plan"; "Company Plan" is not a party name (house rule 11).

notes: Blake's draft, otherwise clean: Aptos 12, A./1./(a) enumeration, digits, "states", no party articles. "Company grants Optionee an option" is language of performance and correct. D.1's "must ... and must pay" are both conditions of exercise.
